rect.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(100%,100%,100%); fill-rule: evenodd;

polygon.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(85%,93%,95%); fill-rule: evenodd;

polyline.style: stroke: rgb(7%,41%,57%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 2.5; fill: None; fill-rule: evenodd;

path.style: stroke: rgb(54%,59%,61%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-dasharray: 5, 4;

circle.style: stroke: rgb(7%,41%,57%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1.3; fill: rgb(100%,100%,100%); fill-rule: evenodd;
